content:
alex: Quick question — PagerDuty -> Slack routing for the new `redwood-ingest` service. We're getting noisy kafka_retries spikes during deploys. Who owns the escalation policy for that service and what's the recommended routing?

mira: I thought Jamal set up the PD service originally. @jamal? Also: are these firing as `critical` or `warning`?

jamal: Yep, I created the service initially. Current escalation policy goes to primary oncall -> eng-oncall -> pager. PD service: https://pagerduty.com/orgs/redwood/services/P12345 (internal). We can either update the Slack integration to post to #ingest-alerts for low-severity or tweak thresholds.

sara: If it's noisy during deploys we should consider suppressing during deploy windows or switch to a 5m sustained condition. Is this `ingest.consumer.retries` metric?

alex: Correct, metric is `ingest.consumer.retries`. Spikes are short (30–60s) and non-actionable. Want to avoid paging on those. Suggested: route low severity to #ingest-alerts, keep high severity to #eng-oncall + PD.

jamal: We can change the PD -> Slack mapping or add a filter in PD. Example CLI to update service integration:

```
pagerduty-cli service update --id P12345 \\  --integration slack \\  --channel "#ingest-alerts" \\  --severity-mapping low:warning,high:critical
```

Also can add a suppression rule for deploy windows. @devex can you provision the channel webhook if we're good?

devex: I can create the webhook. Will need the PD integration name and which channel to post to. Also please add the Grafana dashboard and runbook link to the runbook when you update routing. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/ingest/consumer-retries

sre-lead: Small operational note: don't route ALL alerts away from #eng-oncall. Proposal: route `warning` -> #ingest-alerts only; `critical` -> #eng-oncall + PD. That keeps oncall visibility for anything actionable. :thumbsup:

ops: Agreed. Also add an escalation rule: if `warning` isn't acknowledged in 15m escalate to oncall-manager @mira. We should add a maintenance/CI tag for deploy windows to auto-suppress transient spikes. I can add the maintenance window to PD if you provide the schedule.

oncall-bot: Test alert queued: "ingest consumer retries spike" -> PagerDuty service P12345 (test) at 2024-03-12T18:12:30Z

alex: Cool — jamal, can you make the PD changes? devex, can you provision webhook and drop it into the integration? I'll open a quick PR to update the runbook with dashboard + playbook.

jamal: On it. I'll update the integration and add severity mapping + the 15m escalation step. Will send a test when done.

devex: Webhook created and attached to PD integration: https://hooks.slack.com/services/T000/BBB/ccc (rotating secret). Pushed runbook PR: https://git.redwood.com/redwood/runbooks/pulls/1423 — added dashboard + troubleshooting steps.

jamal: Made the PD changes and set: warning -> #ingest-alerts, critical -> #eng-oncall. Added escalation: no-ack -> escalate to oncall-manager after 15m. Sending test alert now.

oncall-bot: Test alert delivered to #ingest-alerts (severity=warning). PD shows acknowledge requirement.

mira: Acked the test. Observability suggestion: make the alert fire on 5m sustained spikes (avg over 5m) instead of a single-sample threshold. Prevents paging for brief deploy blips.

alex: Thanks all. I'll file a tuning ticket for the sustained-window change and follow up with deploy windows schedule. Ticket: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/RED-321

jamal: Will monitor next 24h and iterate on thresholds if still noisy. Ping me if you see anything odd.

alex: Perfect. Marking this resolved for now — follow-ups in the runbook PR & RED-321. :white_check_mark:
